scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but playable with substantial friction, 7 good with clear shortcomings, 10 exceptional in the assessed scope. Scores are holistic judgments of observed interaction, not outcome rewards or averages; unplayed content earns no assumed enjoyment.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent atmospheric shooter with useful touch assistance, but navigation, occlusion and rear-threat management consumed much of the observed experience. The second run improved markedly through learned inputs, yet the Custodian transition overwhelmed my ability to orient and defend.
reasons.controls: Two-contact move/fire worked, tap aim removed the initial guard reliably, contextual recovery worked, and a dash registered. Scene swipe direction/calibration took practice; dense right-side actions and aim changes while moving made threat tracking awkward. No claim that emulated input friction equals a physical touchscreen.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery objectives and escalating encounters gave clear purpose. Successful second-run recovery of all three memories felt more manageable. Offscreen charge pressure while navigating and holding recovery was frustrating; little room remained to learn the Custodian firing windows. Neither loss alone determines this grade.
reasons.presentation: Strong cyan/amber visual language, rainy reflective facility, distinctive relay landmark and polished title/results gave the observed area a cohesive identity. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, paused planning map, relative PATH cues, recovery prompts and explicit fresh/retry choices were helpful. Route cues did not prevent me walking into cover or losing orientation. Changing use prompts required repeated reading under pressure.
reasons.readability: Health, ammo, objectives and large recovery/result labels were readable. Small terminal telemetry, environmental labels and stacked status/threat/recovery text were harder at 844x390. Large cover/sign surfaces sometimes filled the whole view.

helpfulMoments.observation: Tap guard then hold FIRE cleared opening threat; simple actionable onboarding.
Overview route, wall/cover legend and receiver labels supported planning; map remained open until visibly closed.
Hold approach recovered Mara with no precise walking alignment.
Moving while firing at warden brought me into Sera recovery range with health intact.
PHASE EVADE +75 provided explicit dash success feedback.

frustratingMoments.observation: Close sign filled scene; forward hold had not produced a useful orientation.
Wall corner dominated view while rear charges continued; had to back out and strafe.
Receiver pillar blocked attempted onward movement after recovery.
Turning and moving toward new objective left attacks out of view and rapidly depleted health. Snapshot metadata health 64 differs from screenshot 51, demonstrating live capture timing damage.
